## Purpose and boundary

The Cross Sections tab provides a session-only way to inspect channel and
floodplain inundation before developing cross-section geometry. It uses the
same interactive flooding concept as ohwm2. It does not yet lay out, edit,
resequence, export, or save cross sections; the observed footprints are not a
governed FGDB dataset or a claim of hydraulic-model compliance.

## Function flow

1. `mod_study_server()` mounts `cross_section_review_server()` with the linked
   Survey Event and upstream revision signals. `load_flowline_points_review()`
   resolves the current Event's saved Flowlines, Flowline Points and Hydro DEMs.
2. The selected Stream and Reach determine one Reach Flowline, its points and
   its Stream DEM. A `callr` background process invokes `fluvgeo::detrend()`
   with a 150 m buffer and writes a temporary analytical REM and a reduced,
   projected display raster. The fixed buffer can truncate inundation and is not
   an accepted universal floodplain extent.
3. Slider values are debounced by 400 ms. The channel must be strictly below
   the floodplain elevation. A second background process calls
   `fluvgeo::water_surface_extents()` on the analytical REM. The result retains
   unsimplified original polygons and hole-filled outer footprints; the latter
   are drawn over the map. Default REM elevations 103 and 106 ft are initial
   values, not measured channel and floodplain elevations.
4. The server cancels the previous job when the selection or requested levels
   change, checks the selection and level key before displaying a result, and
   removes session-owned files on session end. A display overview does not
   replace the full-resolution REM used for footprint extraction. Status text
   reports processing and invalid levels.

## Data objects and storage

| Object | Input or output | Representation and owner |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Flowline and Flowline Points | Saved Reach geometry and sampled elevations for the selected Event | Existing local GeoPackage candidates, resolved by the FG Studio store; not new FGDB records |
| Hydro DEM | Saved Stream terrain used for the selected Reach | Existing external GeoTIFF owned by the local Hydro revision |
| REM and display raster | Temporary analytical and map-display surfaces | Session-owned temporary GeoTIFFs; removed at session end |
| Inundation footprints | Original and hole-filled channel/floodplain extents | Transient `sf` results; no saved layer or governed identity |

The future cross-section producer must follow the legacy-derived compatibility
workflow and FGDB profile before emitting a replacement vector. FGDB's physical
binding for cross sections is not resolved by this preview.

## Verification and open work

The `fluvgeo` tests for `water_surface_extents()` check elevation ordering,
CRS, disconnected areas, empty inundation, holes and nested footprints. A
whole-app Spencer Creek R1 review exercised the map, slider update and invalid
level feedback. Initial REM preparation is slow, and caching, broader data
coverage and other reaches require further qualification. The experimental
path and collision diagnostic remains separate from the app and is not a
production layout method. See the local feature record for its findings.
